workflow: Preserve exact source lyrics and successful renderer baseline; separate alternatives.
Identify emotional intent, concrete human detail, narrative change, vocal role and section function; do not force a universal emotional arc.
Select words by context, phonetic stress, syllable count, breath, articulation, rhyme/assonance and rhythmic fit; distinguish approximate linguistic analysis from measured audio.
Use contrast and transformation of an anchor only when musically motivated; preserve deliberate repetitions and silence.
Relate voice to motor, synth response, pressure, space and ending; protect intelligibility and intentional original text.
Translate only musically useful instructions into existing Suno fields; no new fields, no silent truncation, no automatic parenthetical command convention, no claimed exact renderer behavior.
Apply M01–M10 and NMI-R01 regression guard before any promotion; creator-confirmed comparison needed; missing baseline HOLD.
